3W Retail Sales Oct 2026 - Bajaj, Mahindra, Piaggio, TVS, Atul, YC, Saera, Dilli

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • After taking a look at the commercial vehicle sales , let us now take a look at the 3 wheeler segment.
  • India’s 3Wheeler retail market registered total sales of 1,41,420 units in October 2026, comprising 52,850 internal combustion engine (ICE) models and 88,570 electric three-wheelers (EVs).
  • Official reporting verified via Rushlane.com news desk.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

After taking a look at the commercial vehicle sales , let us now take a look at the 3 wheeler segment. India’s 3Wheeler retail market registered total sales of 1,41,420 units in October 2026, comprising 52,850 internal combustion engine (ICE) models and 88,570 electric three-wheelers (EVs). Electric models continued to dominate the segment, accounting for 62.63% of total retail sales, significantly higher than their 52.19% share in October 2025.

📌 The Core Development

In terms of fuel-wise distribution, electric three-wheelers commanded the largest share at 62.63%, up from 52.19% in October 2025. CNG/LPG models accounted for 22.30% of total sales, followed by diesel-powered three-wheelers at 14.85%. Petrol and ethanol-powered models collectively contributed a marginal 0.22% share.

The overall 3W market recorded a 3.97% year-on-year (YoY) growth and a 6.68% month-on-month (MoM) increase. Sales had stood at 1,36,025 units in October 2025 and 1,32,570 units in September 2026, respectively.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

Bajaj Auto continued to lead India’s combined ICE and electric three-wheeler retail market in October 2026, recording sales of 51,810 units and commanding a 36.64% market share. The company registered electric 3W sales of 15,726 units, marking an impressive 91.27% YoY growth over the 8,222 units sold in October 2025. EV sales also improved by 4.08% MoM compared to 15,109 units in September 2026.

Mahindra Group secured second position with 15,918 units sold, translating into an 11.26% market share. Piaggio followed with 9,833 units and a 6.95% share.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

TVS Motor also maintained a notable presence across both ICE and EV categories, recording combined retail sales of 8,566 units. Electric three-wheelers accounted for 5,067 units of its total sales.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

Atul Auto ranked next with 3,457 units sold during the month. However, sales declined from 3,599 units in October 2025, bringing its market share to 2.44%. YC recorded 2,494 units, witnessing a considerable decline from 3,497 units in the corresponding month last year. Saera Electric also reported a YoY decline, with sales falling to 1,805 units from 2,263 units in October 2025.

Dilli Electric also witnessed a decline in its 3W EV sales during October 2026. The company retailed 1,723 units, down 8.64% from 1,886 units in October 2025. On a MoM basis, however, sales registered a marginal improvement of 0.70% over the 1,711 units sold in September 2026.
